name: EPIC 248775308

text.card: A red giant 4,519 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 14, give 0.85 solar masses and 8.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,663 K at its surface.
